externalAudit.limitation: Luna did not freshly rerun Chromium or Firefox because her sandbox lacked the required browser environment. Codex post-fix browser verification is recorded separately.

findings.finding: Core browser renderers retained xScale.domain and yScale.domain as metadata but resolved rendered geometry from automatic data extents.
findings.reproduction: For line x=[0,1,2], xScale.domain=[0,100] resolved to [-0.16,2.16]; the equivalent yScale.domain=[0,100] also resolved to [-0.16,2.16].
findings.oldBehavior: Terminal/resolved domains, Canvas/controller geometry, and SVG geometry ignored authored core scale domains. The temporal extension already honored them.
findings.correctedBehavior: Core numeric domains resolve once with precedence scale domain, supported data-level domain, automatic finite extent. Existing no-hidden-evidence validation still rejects authored domains that clip evidence.

findings.finding: linear_fit emitted plausible horizontal fitted lines when an ordinary least-squares line with intercept was not identifiable.
findings.reproduction: Browser terminal/resolved/SVG and Canvas code produced slope=0, intercept=5 for one point x=[1],y=[5], and slope=0, intercept=2 for constant x=[1,1,1],y=[1,2,3]. Python motion delegated rank-deficient input to numpy.polyfit.
findings.oldBehavior: Browser fit code substituted denominator 1 when x variance was zero; Python had no matching pre-allocation identifiability rule.
findings.correctedBehavior: A requested fit requires at least two finite observations and two distinct finite x values. Unidentifiable requests are rejected path-aware in the portable/browser contract and before Python motion figure allocation. A horizontal fit remains valid when x varies.

codexPostFixBrowserVerification.acceptedOutputChanges: Runtime-rendered geometry now follows existing authored domains for the V2 line/scatter/strip panels and ten accepted core specimen fixtures. Source contracts, corpus data, and accepted evidence files are unchanged. V2 normalized terminal identity changed from fnv1a32-c46d7647 to fnv1a32-f975f5bc because its authored core domains now control axes and mark geometry; static/restrained/expressive terminal invariance remains exact.
